name: Apple Photos
price: free (included with macOS); iCloud+ storage for iCloud Photos is paid
summary: Apple's photo library with iCloud sync across devices. Good for organising and editing a personal photo collection, with people recognition, memories and non-destructive edits.
where_it_wins: iCloud sync with iPhone and iPad
Non-destructive editing of photos and videos
Memories, slideshows with music, shared albums
where_schnellbild_wins: No import: opens any folder, drive or network share as it is
Real file operations: rename, move, copy, dual pane

free.note: Included with macOS; iCloud Photos storage beyond 5 GB is paid iCloud+.

native_apple_silicon.note: arm64e binary (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)).

no_account_no_tracking.note: Works without an Apple Account, but iCloud features need one and Enhanced Visual Search matches photos against an Apple index.

dark_light_setting.note: Follows the macOS appearance; no own theme setting.

languages_20.note: Follows the macOS system language (about 40 languages).

folder_browsing.note: Photos and videos must be imported into a Photos library (or referenced from it).

thumbnail_grid.note: Library grid with Years/Months/All Photos; albums, not file-system folders.

list_view.note: Library views are Years, Months, All Photos (grid); no list with columns.

recursive_search.note: Searches the whole library by content, title, caption, keyword, date; not file names in folders.

regex_search.note: Search by title, caption, keyword, date, content or natural language; no regular expressions.

network_shares_fast.note: Items must be imported into a Photos library first; no browsing of shares.

multiple_windows.note: Single library window; Command-W closes the window and quits Photos.

bookmarks.note: Albums and folders of albums inside the library; no file-system folder bookmarks.

img_modern_formats.note: Imports formats macOS ImageIO reads (HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP); not listed explicitly in the guide.

img_psd_exr.note: PSD files import flattened (layers are lost); OpenEXR not documented.

img_svg_pdf.note: Searched Photos User Guide and Apple Community; no statement on SVG/PDF import.

img_animated.note: Searched Photos User Guide (Media Types page names no Animated collection), web; no source on GIF/APNG/WebP playback in Photos for Mac.

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys between photos, Space to open/close.

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom, drag to pan; rotate is a (non-destructive) edit.

slideshow.note: Instant slideshows with themes and music, plus saved slideshow projects.

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshows of a selection or album mixing photos and videos; no folder tree.

auto_enhance_view.note: Auto Enhance (Command-E) and adjustments are non-destructive; original kept.

file_info_exif.note: Camera metadata (lens, shutter speed, file size), location, device.

wrong_extension_note.note: Info window lists capture metadata, location, albums; no file-type mismatch notice.

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Plays what QuickTime/AVFoundation plays; MKV must be remuxed to MP4 first.

video_skim_arrows.note: Arrow keys go to the next item; no documented skimming.

subtitles_embedded.note: Video controls and editing documented without any subtitle option; Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature.

subtitles_external_files.note: No subtitle support documented; Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature.

audio_track_choice.note: Only Audio Mix for Spatial Audio videos from recent iPhones; no track selection.

playback_speed.note: Slow-motion speeds (1/2, 1/4, 1/5) for high-frame-rate videos only.

control_bar_movable.note: Photos guide only says controls appear when the pointer is over the video; placement not documented.

playlist.note: Instant slideshow plays a selection or album; no editable play queue.

saved_playlists.note: Saved slideshow projects keep an ordered list of photos and videos.

pip.note: Searched Photos User Guide and web; no statement on Picture in Picture.

music_mode.note: Imports and plays photos and videos only.

streaming_urls.note: Plays items in the photo library only.

online_subtitles.note: No subtitle support at all; Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature.

video_filters_enhance.note: Light, colour, filters, crop for videos (non-destructive).

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature; adds no Finder/Quick Look thumbnails.

archives_as_folders.note: Imports photos and videos from files and folders; archives are not covered in the Photos User Guide.

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Imports photos and videos from files and folders; archives are not covered in the Photos User Guide.

archive_passwords.note: Imports photos and videos from files and folders; archives are not covered in the Photos User Guide.

split_archives.note: Imports photos and videos from files and folders; archives are not covered in the Photos User Guide.

videos_in_archives.note: Imports photos and videos from files and folders; archives are not covered in the Photos User Guide.

manga_two_page.note: Shows one photo at a time; Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature.

rename_trash.note: Delete (Recently Deleted) and titles; no file renaming or folders on disk.

move_copy.note: Organises into albums inside the library, not file-system moves.

dual_pane.note: Single library window; Photos User Guide table of contents (full feature list) has no such feature.

undo_file_actions.note: Command-Z undo and Recently Deleted album.

batch_convert.note: Exports several items in a chosen format; no batch rename.

library_catalog.note: Library database with albums, keywords, ratings, people.

cloud_sync.note: iCloud Photos, Shared Albums, Shared Library.

keyboard_first.note: many keyboard shortcuts, not for everything

custom_shortcuts.note: macOS App Shortcuts for menu commands.

boss_key.note: Command-H hides the app; no dedicated boss key.

app_sandbox.note: com.apple.security.app-sandbox entitlement (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)).

no_network.note: iCloud Photos, Shared Albums, Enhanced Visual Search; has the network.client entitlement.
